Class StateSummary<T extends Enum<T> & StateSummaryType>

java.lang.Object
org.tasktide.core.model.state_summary.StateSummary<T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
ItemStateSummary, TaskStateSummary
public abstract class StateSummary<T extends Enum<T> & StateSummaryType> extends Object
JSON-B compatible representation of StateSummaryType maps
Resolves yasson-3.0.>=4 bump where generic key does not seem supported
PR = https://github.com/BrenKenna/TaskTide/pull/15
Commit = https://github.com/BrenKenna/TaskTide/commit/5a4894d3421c9d7a926fa54f7bb9988ef244a60d
